verdict.rationale: Crossplane's own CLI can render Composition Functions standalone without a cluster, so an agent could headlessly preview the managed resources an authored change would produce. The pack never shows this producing a plan or diff against live state for human approval. The `helm install --dry-run` item only covers installing Crossplane itself, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: a documented plan/diff of proposed changes against current infrastructure, an approval gate before apply, agent-oriented headless workflow docs, and hands-on corroboration.
